officialSources.title: Borås Stad: Sjuhäradsleden (orange), flera längder
officialSources.evidence: Lists Etapp 10 as Årås säteri to Hotell Mullsjö, 22 km, 5.5 hours, Medium. Describes a stage mostly on gravel road to Ryfors, then forest/Södra Vätterleden over the final just-over-6 km past Trollsjön, a small beach at Stråken and old pine forest. Gives Årås säteri coordinate 6416792 419809 and Hotell Mullsjö coordinate 6418558 433181.

officialSources.caveat: Difficulty and distance differ from Naturkartan/E1, and the end label alternates between Hotel and Hotell Mullsjö.

commuteAccess.summary: The Årås start remains weak by fixed public transport and is best treated as parking/drop-off or pre-booked demand-responsive access. The Hotell Mullsjö end is the strongest public-transport endpoint on the trail, with JLT bus at Mullsjö Friluftshotellet and rail/bus at Mullsjö Resecentrum via an access trail.

startAccess.caveats: Official start has parking and information. No fixed-route bus stop found at Årås.
Potential access only if the address is accepted by Närtrafik. Must be pre-booked, uses fixed time windows and is not a spontaneous trailhead bus service.
Useful as a transfer target for demand-responsive access, not a practical walk-in access point to Årås; road distance is likely 15+ km.
Closest fixed-route cluster found west of the trail, still too far for normal stage access.

endAccess.caveats: Practical direct endpoint access. Refresh live JLT timetable before publication.

endAccess.operatorNetwork: Västtågen / Jönköpings Länstrafik train 965 and buses 113/116
endAccess.caveats: Best regional public-transport node. Naturkartan lists an orange-marked access trail from Mullsjö C to Hotell Mullsjö, with source length inconsistencies around 1.8-2.3 km.
Useful for the Mullsjö end only; not a solution for the Årås half.

ticketingAndBoundaryCaveats: The stage crosses from Västra Götaland/Ulricehamn/Västtrafik territory into Jönköping/Mullsjö/JLT territory.

JLT Närtrafik is not a general visitor workaround because JLT rules are tied to rural residence/registration and trip limits.
Naturkartan's QA warning means hikers should not rely only on waymarking, especially when linking to the Mullsjö access trail.

Commercial camping/lodging exists at/near endpoints and Mullsjö.

protectedAreas.sectionContext: Start area around Årås säteri/kvarn and nearby local trails.
protectedAreas.rulesSummary: No motor vehicles except roads, no caravan/camper outside parking, no fires, no damaging or removing dead wood/living vegetation, no collecting mosses/lichens/insects/fungi except edible mushrooms, no loose dogs, and livestock grazing occurs.

protectedAreas.rulesSummary: No damaging natural features/vegetation, no picking flowers/fungi/lichens/mosses, no loose dogs, no disturbing wildlife, no parking/driving motor vehicles or other transport, no tenting/caravans, no fires and no riding. Länsstyrelsen notes undermined path near Pinnabron due to a beaver lodge.

protectedAreas.name: Stråkens strandskogar naturreservat
protectedAreas.sectionContext: Relevant for Trollsjön/Stråken shoreline corridor near Mullsjö.

No collecting mosses/lichens/fungi except edible mushrooms for household use or small ID specimens. Larger organized competitions/training and camps require Länsstyrelsen permission. New reserve; signs/boundary markings may still be pending.
protectedAreas.confidence: high for rules; medium for exact route overlap until GIS clipping

dogsLivestockPrivateLand.notes: Årås and Ryfors reserve rules forbid loose dogs; general Swedish seasonal dog-control rules require leash-level control in nature during 1 March-20 August. Årås has sheep/cattle grazing and the route crosses rural/private land; keep dogs leashed, close gates, avoid livestock stress and respect farming, forestry, hunting and fishing.

roadAndSurfaceHazards.notes: Official description and recent field reports agree this is mostly road/gravel walking, with some asphalt and a final forest-trail section near Mullsjö. Wet weather can make the clay/gravel roads unpleasant, and the final forest approach can feel slow/convoluted in poor weather or darkness. No current impassable obstruction was found.

waterSafety.notes: Do not treat lakes or streams as drinking water without boiling/filtering. Södra Vätterleden context says drinking-water refill is not available along the stage; hotel/guest/golf/camping water is service-dependent. Stråken/Trollsjön/Jogen are lake/bathing/rest contexts, not potable-water points.

huntingAndForestry.notes: No current section-10 hunting, forestry closure or route reroute notice was found in checked official trail, municipal, Länsstyrelsen or field-report sources. The route crosses private/working rural land, so temporary local signs, active forestry machinery, hunting notices and landowner instructions must be respected.

closuresAndCurrentness.notes: No section-10-specific closure/reroute was found in official sources or field reports. Naturkartan's trail-wide Västkuststiftelsen QA warning remains relevant. Adjacent/local notices near Ryfors/Stråken concern Ryforsleden/Pinnabron and Stråkenleden/Gyljeryd railway crossing context, not a formal Sjuhäradsleden etapp 10 closure.

emergency.notes: For emergencies, call 112 and provide exact position/nearest road. This section has many road-access portions before Ryfors and stronger public transport at the Mullsjö end, but Årås access requires planning.

conditionReports.summary: Direct E1 field account including Årås/Mullsjö day: mostly minor roads, gravel/clay roads, forest/agricultural areas and deserted summer houses. Weather was cold, wet and sleety. Final approach to Hotell Mullsjö through forest felt convoluted. Hiker personally shortcut/followed road into Mullsjö in poor weather, but did not report a formal closure.
conditionReports.confidence: high for 2025 field character; medium for exact stage-boundary interpretation
conditionReports.importImpact: Add road-heavy/weather-exposed surface note; do not encode the personal shortcut as an official alternate or reroute.

sourceContradictions.description: Borås and OSM tag the section as 22 km. Naturkartan/E1 use 21.3 km or API 21.2 km. Computed Naturkartan linework is about 21.24 km, E1 is about 21.19 km and current OSM about 21.54 km.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Use official rounded 22 km for display; use Naturkartan computed lengths for geometry QA and avoid treating the difference as a route gap.

sourceContradictions.description: Borås lists Medium. Description text calls it an easy stage mostly on road. The shared/connecting Södra Vätterleden stage is Blå - medel.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Use Medium for official difficulty display, with a surface note explaining mostly road walking and final forest trail.

sourceContradictions.description: Borås/Naturkartan use Årås säteri to Hotell/Hotel Mullsjö. Mullsjö, OSM and E1 often use Årås kvarn and describe or publish the physical stage in reverse from Hotel Mullsjö to Årås kvarn.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Use official Sjuhäradsleden order Årås-to-Mullsjö. Store Årås kvarn and Årås Säteri & Trädgårdar as aliases in the Årås endpoint cluster. Do not infer a route reversal problem from Mullsjö/E1 reverse presentation.

sourceContradictions.topic: OSM relation order vs OSM tags
sourceContradictions.description: OSM relation tags say from Årås kvarn to Hotel Mullsjö, but member order is Hotel-to-Årås. Geometry is topologically continuous after orienting ways.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: If OSM is used, assemble by topology and reverse to official stage order before comparing/exporting.

sourceContradictions.description: Naturkartan and OSM endpoints agree closely, but local deviations reach about 80-103 m and OSM computes about 0.30 km longer than Naturkartan.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Use Naturkartan as primary and OSM as cross-check/overlap source; treat imported geometry as planning-grade until field/steward QA.

sourceContradictions.description: Mapped fire/rest sites exist near Årås, Trollsjön/Stråken and Mullsjö, but protected-area rules differ: Årås and Ryfors prohibit fires, while Stråkens strandskogar allows fires only at designated places with own firewood.
sourceContradictions.importImpact: Clip all fire/shelter candidates against reserve polygons and preserve reserve-specific rule text. Suppress or mark pending any firepit where legality is unclear.

lanes.summary: Confirmed official identity, Borås 22 km/5.5 h/Medium, Naturkartan 21.3 km and API 21.2 km, Årås-to-Hotell-Mullsjö endpoint labels, stage description, Mullsjö reverse-direction description, Smålandsleden/Vätterleden connector context and protected-area source set.

Audited Naturkartan API/GPX, OSM relation 5607240 and E1 Hiking Europe GPX. Confirmed continuous Naturkartan geometry in official order, OSM continuous but ordered reverse relative to its tags, E1 reverse direction and overlaps with Änglaleden, Ryforsleden, Södra Vätterleden and Mullsjö Runt.

Found Årås parking/lodging, Struntfiskeboa shelter/firepit candidate, EJ Farm, Ryfors Golfklubb, Ryfors reserve entrance/toilet/waste, Ryfors Smedja, Trollsjön, Stråken naturbad, Stråkensbro, Gyljeryd heritage points, Mullsjö Camping, Hotell Mullsjö services and Mullsjö C access metadata.

Confirmed Årås has no practical fixed-route public transport and relies on parking/drop-off or pre-booked Västtrafik Närtrafik if address accepted. Confirmed Hotell Mullsjö has practical endpoint bus access at Mullsjö Friluftshotellet and rail/bus via Mullsjö Resecentrum plus an access trail.

Found direct 2025 E1 account and FKT/community reports confirming mostly road/gravel/asphalt character, final forest trail into Mullsjö, weather sensitivity and no reported formal closure. Årås lodging operated in 2025 but remains booking/season-dependent.

Confirmed Årås, Ryfors and Stråkens strandskogar protected-area rules, local dog/camping/fire constraints, dynamic fire-ban caveat, no section-10 closure/reroute, and nearby Ryforsleden/Stråkenleden warnings that should not be treated as Sjuhäradsleden closures.

importReadiness.summary: Section 10 has enough official source, GPX/API/OSM/E1 geometry, facilities, commute/access, field-report and protected-area rules evidence for normalization. It is not ready for direct runtime import because Årås and Hotell Mullsjö endpoint clusters must be deduplicated, OSM must be reversed if used, local OSM/Naturkartan deviations should be reviewed, protected-area rules must be clipped to facility candidates, service water is not confirmed as free public water, and transit/fire status is dynamic.
importReadiness.descriptionDraft: Etapp 10 runs from the Årås estate and mill area to Hotell Mullsjö. It is a long but mostly easy-going road stage: gravel and minor roads lead east through rural countryside toward Ryfors, then the final just over 6 km turn into forest and follow Södra Vätterleden past Ryfors gammelskog, Trollsjön, Stråken and old pine forest. Årås has parking and booked/seasonal services but weak fixed-route transit; the Mullsjö end has the trail's strongest public-transport access, with bus at Friluftshotellet and rail/bus via Mullsjö station. Plan water and services carefully and respect reserve-specific fire, camping and dog rules.
importReadiness.recommendedGeometry: Use Naturkartan Etapp 10 GPX/API as the primary planning-grade geometry in official Årås-to-Hotell-Mullsjö order. Use OSM relation 5607240 only after reversing/assembling by topology and as a cross-check for Södra Vätterleden, Ryforsleden, Änglaleden and Mullsjö Runt overlaps. Do not use reverse E1 direction to change official section order.
importReadiness.recommendedEndpointPolicy: Use Naturkartan GPX endpoints for route continuity. Model Årås säteri, Årås kvarn, Årås Säteri & Trädgårdar, Årås parking and STF/Årås lodging/food as one start access/service/heritage cluster with aliases. Model Hotell Mullsjö route endpoint separately from the hotel building, ledentré, bus stop, bathing place and Mullsjö C access trail.
recommendedFacilityPolicy: Import Årås trailhead/parking and Årås lodging/heritage cluster with seasonal/customer caveats.
Keep Struntfiskeboa shelter/firepit pending until protected-area boundary and legality are verified.
Keep EJ Farm Glassfabrik and VIP restaurant/motel pending until opening/currentness is verified.
Import Ryfors Smedja/rest area, Ryfors reserve entrance parking/toilet/waste and Ryfors Gammelskog as rest/access/rules context, with no fire/camping claims.
Import Stråkensbro, Trollsjön rastplats and Stråken naturbad as final-corridor rest/heritage/swimming POIs, but verify fire legality for any grill/fireplace display.
Import Mullsjö Camping as commercial camping and Hotell Mullsjö as lodging/food/access, but keep drinking-water tap pending exact public-access verification.
Model Mullsjö Friluftshotellet bus stop and Mullsjö C/Resecentrum as endpoint access metadata, not facilities on the main route.
majorCaveats: Distance differs: 22 km official municipal/OSM value vs 21.2-21.3 km Naturkartan/E1 and about 21.24 km computed Naturkartan linework.
Difficulty is Medium in Borås but the descriptive text says easy and mostly road; explain both.
Årås fixed-route transit is poor; Närtrafik may be possible only by pre-booking and address eligibility.
Hotell Mullsjö has strong public transport compared with earlier stages, but live JLT schedules must be refreshed.
No confirmed free public potable water on the road section; endpoint/nearby water is guest/customer/seasonal or pending exact tap verification.
Årås and Ryfors reserve rules prohibit fires; Stråkens strandskogar fire rules require designated places and brought firewood.
OSM relation is continuous but ordered opposite to official stage direction and differs locally from Naturkartan by up to about 100 m.
Naturkartan/Västkuststiftelsen quality-assurance warning remains relevant; no section-specific closure was found.
